name: Interstate Waste Services (IWS)
notes: Moved from the catalog default utility-account family to the trash-specific waste-hauler family. Researched from the public interstatewaste.com home page, Customer Support page and FAQ, and the public MyIWS portal landing page (Sign In, Quick Pay, Create new MyIWS Account); never signed in. MyIWS sign-up: enter an e-mail to get a verification code, then set a password and name; the account links automatically when the e-mail matches a contact on file, otherwise with the Customer ID and postal code (registrationFields accountNumber+zip+email; the sign-up e-mail code is not a sign-in MFA, so mfa stays none). In MyIWS customers make one-time payments, enroll in AutoPay, view schedules, rates and open invoices, report missed pickups and order containers; payments are handed to Billtrust. Payment methods: major credit cards (a convenience fee may apply; not charged on personal debit cards; amount not published, so fees.notes only), debit, checking/ACH and mailed checks (Westmont Lockbox, PO Box 88500, Chicago, IL). Pay by phone at 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497), press 1. Card payments post in 1-3 business days, checks up to 4 weeks. Payment plans and credit-hold questions go to 1-866-DIAL-IWS. Statements: Billtrust or billing@interstatewaste.com. Customer service Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.-5 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.-12:30 p.m. ET. Turning AutoPay off and paperless enrolment are not described publicly (autopay_cancel inferred; paperless left at the family default). IWS warns customers against paying through doxo.

registration.note: Create a MyIWS account with your e-mail and a verification code. If your e-mail is not already on file, link your account with the Customer ID from your invoice and your postal code.

pay_online.note: Card payments post within 1-3 business days.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are set up by phone. Call 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497) and IWS will work with you to avoid a gap in service.

cancel_service.note: Service changes are made by customer service. Call 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497) or e-mail customerservice@interstatewaste.com.

notes: A convenience fee may apply to credit card payments; it is not charged on personal debit cards.

help.title: How to pay your IWS bill
paragraphs: The easiest way to pay is MyIWS: make a one-time payment or enroll in AutoPay. IWS accepts major credit cards, debit cards, checking account/ACH and mailed checks.
A convenience fee may apply to credit cards; personal debit cards are recognized and not charged the fee. Card payments post in 1-3 business days; checks can take up to 4 weeks.
Pay by phone at 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497), option 1. Mail checks to Westmont Lockbox, Interstate Waste Services, PO Box 88500, Chicago, IL.

help.title: How to sign up for MyIWS
paragraphs: Choose Create new MyIWS Account and enter your e-mail address to receive a verification code. After verifying, create a password and enter your first and last name.
If your e-mail matches a contact on file, the account links automatically. Otherwise you are asked for your Customer ID (on your invoice) and postal code.

help.title: Credit hold and payment plans
paragraphs: The fastest way off credit hold is to pay the outstanding bill in full online; allow 2-3 business days for it to post. If you cannot pay in full or want a payment plan, call 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497).

help.title: Customer service hours
paragraphs: Customer service is open Monday through Friday 7:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Eastern. Call 1-866-DIAL-IWS (1-866-342-5497). Billing questions and statement copies: billing@interstatewaste.com.

extra.intent: Using IWS's help pages, find which type of card payment is never charged the card convenience fee. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Personal debit cards are not charged the convenience fee (it may apply to credit cards).
